task:
You answer questions about 3GPP RAN1 standardization records using only a full-text search tool over the RAN1 record chunks (meeting-report decision chunks, CR chunks and contribution chunks, each printed with its metadata). Run the tool from the repository root with Bash:
  PYTHONPATH=scripts/common python3 scripts/publication/paper/ongoing/sigir-2027-research/search_records_text.py --wg RAN1 [--query "<withheld sha256=362240f1056e28de0d48d186c00e362252f4ec5298a619ea02d336b05023176b chars=5>" [--tdoc NUMBER] [--top N] [--chars N] [--collection NAME] [--raw]
--query "<withheld sha256=1f64fff08d787e732e04559f4d241876b399d9d4251af79833bd22adbb2d331a chars=4>" a BM25 search; --raw passes an FTS5 MATCH expression; --tdoc keeps only chunks whose document number (or, for an RP- number, CR pack number) matches exactly; --chars 0 prints whole chunks. You may search as many times as you need and follow any identifier you read. Do not open any other file, database, graph or service. Answer with a JSON object {"rows": [[...], ...]}. Each row lists the requested fields in this order: <the item's fields>. Use document numbers, meeting names and clause numbers exactly as written in the records (for example R4-2205027, RAN4#102-e, RP-221234, RAN#96, 6.2.1). Disposition values are lower-case codes such as agreed, revised, noted, endorsed, withdrawn, not_pursued. If the records hold no such row, answer {"rows": []}.

items.question: TSG RAN CR pack RP-231232 carries change requests from RAN1. Take each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN1 disposition for the whole document and each clause it modifies in the release that change request targets (Rel-17). For each such clause, look at the change requests of that release that modify the same clause and give every CR pack of the latest earlier TSG RAN meeting in the records that carried such a change request; leave out clauses with no earlier pack. Give the specification, the clause, the CR pack document number, and the TSG RAN meeting.
